task_input: Harden core/scripts/stages/release.ts discoverShippedPRs so a commit subject ending in a single `(#N)` is not automatically treated as a shipped pull request. Preserve genuine squash-merge and merge-commit detection. For a suffix-only candidate, classify it through the existing injected release dependency: exclude it with a warning when GitHub says it is not a pull request, but retain it when classification itself fails. Add focused regression tests.

implementing.plan: Separate unambiguous merge-commit PR numbers from suffix-only candidates, classify only the suffix candidates through an injected dependency, retain genuine PRs and classification-error candidates, and add a regression test for a docs commit ending in an issue reference.

hidden_checks: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { discoverShippedPRs } from './core/scripts/stages/release.ts'; const warnings=[]; const deps={runCommand:()=>({code:0,stdout:'docs: release note (#451)\nfeat: shipped feature (#203)',stderr:''}),fetchPRTitle:async n=>'PR #'+n,classifyPR:async n=>n===451?{kind:'not-a-pr'}:{kind:'pr'},stderr:m=>warnings.push(m)}; const prs=await discoverShippedPRs('v1.20.0','.',deps); assert.deepEqual(prs,[{number:203,title:'PR #203'}]); assert.ok(warnings.some(m=>m.includes('#451')&&m.includes('not a pull request')));"

acceptance_criteria.statement: A suffix-only candidate that GitHub classifies as not a pull request is excluded and produces a warning.
